chunks: 2807 - And in the narration of Mu‘āwiyah ibn ‘Ammār, from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
“Whoever shortens the tawaf in the Hijr must repeat his tawaf from the Black Stone.”

key_terms.الطَّوَافَ: the ritual circumambulation of the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْحَجَرِ الْأَسْوَدِ: the Black Stone, from which tawaf begins
key_terms.الْحِجْرِ: the Hijr adjacent to the Ka'bah, through which one must not cut during tawaf

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone passes through the Hijr during tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tawaf during hajj or 'umrah. If a person cuts through the Hijr while performing tawaf, the circuit is considered deficient and the tawaf must be repeated beginning from al-Ḥajar al-Aswad.
